name: ScrapingBee
description: Scrapes web pages to text, HTML or screenshots and pulls Google, Amazon, Walmart and YouTube results as JSON through a hosted MCP server and REST API.

skills.name: Scrape Page Content
skills.description: Fetches a URL with JavaScript rendering and blocking handled, returning its content as text, markdown or rendered HTML.

skills.name: Extract Page Data
skills.description: Extracts specific fields from a page with CSS or XPath selectors and returns them as structured data.

skills.name: Search the Web
skills.description: Runs fast web searches or full Google SERP queries for news, maps, shopping and images, returning clean JSON results.

skills.name: Amazon and Walmart Data
skills.description: Searches Amazon and Walmart and returns product details, pricing and seller offers by ASIN or product ID.

skills.name: Capture Screenshots
skills.description: Captures a screenshot of any URL, or downloads a file such as a PDF or image from it, for the agent to use.
